methods.summary: Returns the total number of patterns compiled into this `BoundedBacktracker`.

methods.name: reset_cache
methods.summary: Reset the given cache such that it can be used for searching with the this `BoundedBacktracker` (and only this `BoundedBacktracker`).

methods.name: try_captures
methods.signature: fn try_captures<'h, I: Into<Input<'h>>>(&self, cache: &mut Cache, input: I, caps: &mut Captures) -> Result<(), MatchError>
methods.summary: Executes a leftmost forward search and writes the spans of capturing groups that participated in a match into the provided [`Captures`] value. If no match was found, then [`Captures::is_match`] is guaranteed to return `false`.

methods.name: try_captures_iter
methods.signature: fn try_captures_iter<'r, 'c, 'h, I: Into<Input<'h>>>(&'r self, cache: &'c mut Cache, input: I) -> TryCapturesMatches<'r, 'c, 'h>
methods.summary: Returns an iterator over all non-overlapping `Captures` values. If no match exists, then the iterator yields no elements.

methods.name: try_find
methods.signature: fn try_find<'h, I: Into<Input<'h>>>(&self, cache: &mut Cache, input: I) -> Result<Option<Match>, MatchError>
methods.summary: Executes a leftmost forward search and returns a `Match` if one exists.

methods.name: try_find_iter
methods.signature: fn try_find_iter<'r, 'c, 'h, I: Into<Input<'h>>>(&'r self, cache: &'c mut Cache, input: I) -> TryFindMatches<'r, 'c, 'h>
methods.summary: Returns an iterator over all non-overlapping leftmost matches in the given bytes. If no match exists, then the iterator yields no elements.

methods.name: try_is_match
methods.signature: fn try_is_match<'h, I: Into<Input<'h>>>(&self, cache: &mut Cache, input: I) -> Result<bool, MatchError>
methods.summary: Returns true if and only if this regex matches the given haystack.

methods.name: try_search
methods.signature: fn try_search(&self, cache: &mut Cache, input: &Input<'_>, caps: &mut Captures) -> Result<(), MatchError>
methods.summary: Executes a leftmost forward search and writes the spans of capturing groups that participated in a match into the provided [`Captures`] value. If no match was found, then [`Captures::is_match`] is guaranteed to return `false`.

methods.name: try_search_slots
methods.signature: fn try_search_slots(&self, cache: &mut Cache, input: &Input<'_>, slots: &mut [Option<NonMaxUsize>]) -> Result<Option<PatternID>, MatchError>
methods.summary: Executes a leftmost forward search and writes the spans of capturing groups that participated in a match into the provided `slots`, and returns the matching pattern ID. The contents of the slots for patterns other than the matching pattern…
